capabilities: search text in vault images from the command palette
copy an image's recognized text to the clipboard
create an index note so Obsidian's search finds image text
read new and changed images in the background (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, HEIC, TIFF, BMP)
extras: Mac-only for reading images; on iPhone/iPad search works from stored index. Builds a helper with Xcode command line tools (xcrun swiftc) or falls back to AppleScript. No network use, no telemetry, not affiliated with Apple.
problem: Obsidian cannot search the words inside images, so screenshots and scanned pages are only findable by filename or tags.

relations.evidence: Organize's "Text from images" is the same reader. With it on, Tahoe OCR searches Organize's index instead

requires.name: macOS (Vision OCR); optionally Xcode command line tools

summary: OCR plugin that reads text in vault images (screenshots, slides, scans) with macOS Vision, so images are searchable and their text copyable.
